raw.query: WITH target AS (SELECT f.run_id, f.window_name, f.model, f.quantile, f.rho, f.cold_start_s, f.lead_s, f.readiness, f.actuation, f.p99_ms, f.feasible, f.provisioned_ws, d.is_current, d.superseded_by FROM provenance.current_factorial f JOIN provenance.v_dim d USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND f.run_id = 'factorial:issue-time:aggregate:chronos:L30:warm:resNone:rho15:cs30:hyNone:forecast:p90'), denom AS (SELECT DISTINCT denominator_kind, denominator_run, denominator_worker_seconds, denominator_workers, denominator_window, denominator_basis, denominator_window_mismatch FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current AND denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' AND denominator_window = 'aggregate'), expected_backing AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE policy = 'forecast' AND quantile = 'p90' AND window_name = 'aggregate') AS forecast_p90_aggregate_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_ratio BETWEEN 0.615 AND 0.625) AS near_062_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_ratio BETWEEN 0.615 AND 0.625 AND policy = 'forecast') AS near_062_forecast_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_ratio BETWEEN 0.615 AND 0.625 AND policy = 'reactive') AS near_062_reactive_rows FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current), breakdown AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.window_name <> 'aggregate') AS in_span_window_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.window_name <> 'aggregate' AND f.feasible) AS feasible_in_span_window_rows, BOOL_AND(f.feasible) FILTER (WHERE f.window_name <> 'aggregate') AS every_in_span_window_feasible, STRING_AGG(f.window_name || ':' || f.p99_ms::text || 'ms:' || f.feasible::text, ', ' ORDER BY f.window_name) FILTER (WHERE f.window_name <> 'aggregate') AS per_window_breakdown FROM provenance.current_factorial f JOIN provenance.v_dim d USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND f.model = 'chronos' AND f.quantile = 'p90' AND f.rho = 15 AND f.cold_start_s = 30 AND f.lead_s = 30 AND f.readiness = 'warm' AND f.actuation = 'issue-time'), sla AS (SELECT bound_ms, bound_stat FROM provenance.v_sla_bound WHERE sla_metric = 'encoder_delay') SELECT t.run_id, t.is_current, t.superseded_by, t.provisioned_ws AS forecast_worker_seconds, d.denominator_kind, d.denominator_workers, d.denominator_worker_seconds AS static_worker_seconds, t.provisioned_ws / d.denominator_worker_seconds AS computed_cost_ratio, d.denominator_window_mismatch, t.p99_ms AS aggregate_p99_ms, t.feasible AS aggregate_feasible, s.bound_stat, s.bound_ms, b.in_span_window_rows, b.feasible_in_span_window_rows, b.every_in_span_window_feasible, b.per_window_breakdown, e.forecast_p90_aggregate_rows AS v_cost_ratio_forecast_p90_aggregate_rows, e.near_062_rows AS v_cost_ratio_near_062_rows, e.near_062_forecast_rows AS v_cost_ratio_near_062_forecast_rows, e.near_062_reactive_rows AS v_cost_ratio_near_062_reactive_rows FROM target t CROSS JOIN denom d CROSS JOIN breakdown b CROSS JOIN expected_backing e CROSS JOIN sla s
